name: City Council - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 13, 2016 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 12/9/2015 Special Meeting, 12/9/2015 Regular Meeting and 12/16/2015 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-01-13 Item 8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-01-13 Item 8B Warrants
8C.
Adoption of Ordinance 2015-19 maintaining local regulatory control over and continuing to prohibit the cultivation of medical marijuana in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-19, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Re-Affirming and Confirming that the Cultivation of Marijuana is Prohibited Pursuant to the Permissive Zoning Code Enacted in the Encinitas Municipal Code; and, therefore, the State is Prohibited from Issuing a License for the Cultivation of Marijuana in the City of Encinitas."
2016-01-13 Item 8C Medical Marijuana
8D.
Cancelation of certain 2016 City Council meetings to accommodate the annual summer recess and the holidays. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Council approve canceling the July 27, August 10, November 23, December 21 and December 28 City Council meetings to accommodate the annual summer recess and the holidays.
2016-01-13 Item 8D 2016 Meeting Cancelations
8E.
Adoption of Ordinance 2015-16 adding Chapter 1.10 to the Encinitas Municipal Code to include provisions for a voluntary mediation program for land use and development projects. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
Adopt Ordinance No. 2015-16, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California adding Chapter 1.10 to the Encinitas Municipal Code to include provisions for a voluntary mediation program for land use and development projects".
2016-01-13 Item 8E Adoption of Ordinance 2015-16 Mediation Program - Reduced
8F.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2016-05 authorizing the execution of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City and the Encinitas Firefighters Association (EFFA). Contact Person: HR Department Manager Dunphy
Adopt Resolution No. 2016-05 authorizing the City Manager to execute, on behalf of the City of Encinitas, a Memorandum of Understanding between the City and the Encinitas Firefighters Association (EFFA) incorporating the terms of the Tentative Agreement which has been ratified by the EFFA.
2016-01-13 Item 8F EFFA MOU Report
8G.
2015 State Homeland Security Grant in the amount of $38,750 for the purchase and installation of a new emergency standby generator, in conjunction with the City Hall Sewer Rehabilitation Project. Contact Person: Sr. Management Analyst Gallup
1. Accept $38,750 in federal funds from a 2015 State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) grant awarded to the City of Encinitas for the purchase and installation of a new emergency standby generator; 2. Authorize the Acting Fire Chief, or his designee, to sign and submit the required California Governor's Office of Emergency Services Fiscal Year (FY) 2015 Grant Assurances (Attachment 1); and 3. Adopt Resolution 2016-03 (Attachment 2) amending the Fiscal Year 2015-2016 budget, allowing for a budget adjustment for additional revenue in the amount of $38,750 for the City Hall Sewer Rehabilitation Project (CF15A).
2016-01-13 Item 8G Acceptance of 2015 SHSGP Grant Funds
8H.
Construction contract for the Fiber Optic Interconnect Projects, CS14E & CS14F. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Baker
1. Approve a contract with DBX Incorporated in the amount of $729,267.00 for the construction of the Fiber Optic Interconnect Projects, a HSIP project (Attachment 1); and 2. Authorize the Director of Public Works to execute the agreement and any extension/amendments including potential change orders in an amount not to exceed $805,000.
2016-01-13 Item 8H Fiber Optic Interconnect Project
8I.
Requesting City Council direction as to the continuation of use of the Pacific View Site by Leucadia Towing, Encinitas Glass and the Encinitas Union School District. Contact Person: Deputy City Engineer Shields
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute three separate, six month Compliance and License Agreements (Attachments 1, 2 and 3) related to the use of the Pacific View site by Leucadia Towing, Encinitas Glass and Encinitas Unified School District.
2016-01-13 Item 8I Use of PV School Site - Leucadia Towing & Encinitas Glass
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2016-03, which, if adopted, would amend Encinitas Municipal Code (EMC) Chapter 2.16 titled, Campaign Regulations, to remove time limits for signs displaying political or other noncommercial messages, whereby the display of such signs is permitted at all times. Project No. 15-282 POD. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1. Receive the staff report; 2. Open the public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and 3. Consider introducing draft Ordinance No. 2016-03 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas amending Chapter 2.16, Campaign Regulations, of the Encinitas Municipal Code" as reflected in Attachment "A" for the reasons specified in the Agenda Report.
2016-01-13 Item 10A Campaign Regulations Municipal Code 2.16
10B.
Fundraising Policy Subcommittee - Selection of a replacement member for Teresa Barth. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
City Council to select one of its members to serve on the Fundraising Policy Subcommittee.
2016-01-13 Item 10B Fundraising Policy Subcommittee replacement member
10C.
Senior Citizen Commission recommendation to fund an ElderHelp HomeShare Program in Encinitas. Contact Person: Recreation Superintendent Gorham
1. Receive a report from the Senior Citizen Commission requesting $15,000 from the General Fund for the proposed ElderHelp HomeShare program; and 2. Provide direction to the City Manager.
2016-01-13 Item 10C ElderHelp HomeShare
2016-01-13 Item 10C ElderHelp HomeShare - Updated 1-11-2016
10D.
Fire Management Services Governance Board request to proceed with Fire Chief recruitment concurrently with the inquiry to the City of Carlsbad regarding joining the Fire Management Services. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Receive the report and provide direction as necessary.
2016-01-13 Item 10D Comprehensive Fire Agreement Report
10E.
Leo Mullen Sports Park Synthetic Turf Installation Project. Contact Person: Director of Parks and Recreation Rudloff
Discuss and provide direction regarding the Leo Mullen Sports Park synthetic turf installation project.
2016-01-13 Item 10E Leo Mullen Turf
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
City Manager Report pursuant to Encinitas Municipal Code Section 7.18.060 regarding the circumstances of purchases and work performed related to damage that has occurred to the roadbed supporting Coast Highway 101 in the 2400 block of South Coast Highway 101, as well as the erosion that has occurred along Moonlight Beach, due to tidal and wave action and the resulting dangerous conditions.
The memorandum dated December 22, 2015 containing the City Manager's determination of the emergency is provided as part of this agenda item.
A full report will be presented orally at this meeting for the purposes of updating the City Council regarding the emergency.
2016-01-13 Item 11A Emergency Declaration - Emergency Repairs at Coastal Locations
11B.
City Manager Report pursuant to Encinitas Municipal Code Section 7.18.080 regarding the circumstances of purchases and work performed related to the Storm Drain outlet failure along the west side of N. Coast Highway 101, causing major erosion, threatening the stability of the roadbed along with a power pole that provides power to Leucadia Wastewater District's Batiquitos Sewer Pump Station.
The memorandum dated January 4, 2016 containing the City Manager's determination of the emergency is provided as part of this agenda item.
A full report will be presented orally at this meeting for the purposes of updating the City Council regarding the emergency.
2016-01-13 Item 11B Emergency Declaration No Coast Hwy 101
11C.
Discussion of an electric vehicle (EV) fast-charging station facility proposed at the City Hall overflow parking lot located on the corner of Vulcan Avenue and E Street. Contact Person: Associate Planner Innes
1. Receive report; 2. Receive and consider public testimony; and 3. Provide direction to staff, as appropriate
2016-01-13 Item 11C Electric Vehicle Charging Station
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Mayor Gaspar regarding a proposal for naming rights of the Encinitas Library.
2016-01-13 Item 12A Mayor Gaspar Council Initiated Item - Naming of Encinitas Library
12B.
Council initiated item from Mayor Gaspar regarding addressing homelessness in Encinitas.
2016-01-13 Item 12B Mayor Gaspar Council Initiated Item - Homelessness in Encinitas
12A.
Council initiated item from Mayor Gaspar regarding a proposal for naming rights of the Encinitas Library.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2016-01-13 Item 15 City Council Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
